query: The automobile is stalled; has no blue light; is not fueled; is not locked.
fact: a road vehicle goes to Cedar if it is stalled, and to Birch otherwise
text:
Sorting Notes for the Car

Case: locked, stalled, fueled, blue light present
Routed to: Cedar

Case: not locked, not stalled, fueled, blue light present
Routed to: Birch

Case: locked, not stalled, not fueled, no blue light
Routed to: Birch

Case: not locked, stalled, not fueled, blue light present
Routed to: Cedar

Case: locked, stalled, fueled, no blue light
Routed to: Cedar

Case: not locked, not stalled, not fueled, blue light present
Routed to: Birch

Case: not locked, stalled, fueled, blue light present
Routed to: Cedar

Case: not locked, not stalled, not fueled, no blue light
Routed to: Birch

Routing rule:

Every car that arrives at the depot is routed to the Cedar queue or the Birch queue. Route stalled cars to Cedar; route all others to Birch. Remaining properties have no bearing on queue selection. The remaining properties (blue light, fueled, locked) are logged for every item and do not affect the route.
